name: EX-12 Maritime Patrol & Interdiction — 3 Days
description: 72-hour maritime security exercise covering coastal patrol operations, vessel interdiction, search and rescue coordination, and joint operations with air assets. Day/night operations cycle. Suitable for Coast Guard, Maritime Police, Naval patrol, and joint operations headquarters exercises.

items.title: INITEX — All Units Deployed
items.description: Exercise commenced. Patrol Vessel Alpha and Bravo cleared port. Maritime patrol aircraft airborne. MOC assumes operational control. Communications nets established on all frequencies. Patrol sectors assigned.

items.title: Coastal Patrol — Alpha Sector
items.description: PV Alpha conducts systematic patrol of coastal sector. AIS anomalies logged. One unregistered small craft observed and documented. Weather conditions: moderate sea state, visibility 8nm.

items.title: INJECT: Suspicious Vessel — Possible Drug Smuggling
items.description: EXERCISE INJECT: Intelligence tip passed from national drug enforcement — semi-rigid inflatable craft with 4 occupants, running without AIS, believed carrying narcotics. Bearing and estimated position passed to PV Alpha. Interception track calculated. Air support tasked for overwatch.

items.title: Vessel Boarding & Inspection
items.description: PV Alpha intercepts and boards target vessel per boarding procedures. Vessel inspection conducted: 2 packages of suspected narcotics found in concealed compartment. Occupants detained. Evidence documented under chain of custody. MOC notified. Port authority alerted for processing.

items.title: INJECT: Distress Call — Vessel Taking Water
items.description: EXERCISE INJECT: MAYDAY received from recreational vessel 12nm offshore — vessel taking water, 3 persons on board. SAR operation initiated. PV Bravo diverted. Helicopter tasked. MOC coordinates with national SAR centre.

items.title: SAR Rescue Operations
items.description: PV Bravo arrives on scene. Helicopter hovers for overwatch. Rescue swimmers deployed. All 3 persons safely recovered. Casualties assessed — 1 hypothermia case, medevac to shore via helicopter. SAR operation stood down. Vessel deemed unsalvageable.

items.title: ENDEX
items.description: Exercise ended. All vessels return to port. Aircraft returning to base. All detainees and rescue subjects handed over to appropriate authorities per exercise scenario. Personnel and equipment accountability complete.

items.title: After Action Review
items.description: Full AAR covering: boarding procedures, SAR coordination, communications, intelligence-operations integration, inter-agency coordination. Lessons learned documented. Follow-up training requirements identified.
